objective.statement: Keep one managed J-Code runtime able to route Kimi K3 and MiniMax M3 directly to their native APIs while retaining explicit CentralCloud gateway fallbacks.
objective.measure: The live swarm catalog simultaneously lists direct kimi:k3, direct minimax-direct:MiniMax-M3, and explicit llm-gateway K3/M3 routes while exactly one J-Code daemon remains active.

need.statement: J-Code currently exposes K3 and M3 only through llm-gateway even though separate native-provider subscriptions and SOPS credentials exist.
stakeholders: The root J-Code swarm coordinator selecting worker routes.
need.baseline: The live picker has 128 llm-gateway routes and zero direct Kimi or MiniMax routes; the daemon has no direct credentials, Kimi's env file is absent, MiniMax's is empty, and the global prompt incorrectly forbids gateway fallback.
need.consequence_of_no_action: The coordinator cannot use the direct subscriptions, cannot distinguish direct from gateway routing reliably, and loses the requested fallback choice.
alternatives_considered: Activate the old gateway-only Home Manager branch
Patch the J-Code MiniMax key-prefix endpoint heuristic before enabling any direct route
Override the built-in minimax profile with a same-name configured profile

purpose: Keep one managed J-Code runtime able to route Kimi K3 and MiniMax M3 directly to their native APIs while retaining explicit CentralCloud gateway fallbacks.
consumer: Mikael and the root J-Code swarm coordinator on cc-se-sto-devbox-01.
contract: Home Manager owns one J-Code launcher, mutable provider preferences, global swarm prompt, and SOPS-backed provider credential files; direct kimi:k3 and minimax-direct:MiniMax-M3 routes coexist with explicit llm-gateway K3/M3 routes without creating a second daemon or embedding secrets.
failure_boundary: Fail closed if a native credential is missing, a direct-prefixed route resolves through llm-gateway, the managed preferences would clobber unrelated J-Code settings, or activation would create a second runtime. Keep the existing gateway coordinator available on any direct-provider failure.

evidence.description: Focused tests prove the mutable config merger, SOPS-only credential rendering, one-launcher wiring, prompt policy, and explicit route names.
Authenticated catalog-only probes and the live swarm route list prove direct and gateway coexistence without paid inference.

falsifier.claim: One live J-Code runtime exposes direct-preferred K3/M3 routes and explicit gateway fallbacks with isolated SOPS credentials.

executable_check.description: Run focused repository tests, catalog-only provider probes, swarm list_models, and the single-daemon process check.
executable_check.command: node --test scripts/test-nix-tooling.mjs && python3 scripts/test-jcode-preferences.py && repo check

non_goals: Send paid chat, streaming, or tool-loop probes
Change the Umans GLM coordinator default
Implement quota sensing or autonomous ambient scheduling
Patch and publish the upstream J-Code MiniMax region heuristic in this change
Activate the obsolete gateway-only runtime directory
invariants: jcode-server.service remains the only long-lived J-Code daemon
Direct and gateway route names remain visibly distinct
Provider secret values never enter tracked files or the Nix store
Unrelated live J-Code config tables and keys survive preference application

assumptions.statement: The native Kimi catalog continues to expose model id k3.
assumptions.falsifier: A fresh authenticated catalog-only model list omits k3.

assumptions.statement: A named openai-compatible profile at https://api.minimax.io/v1 avoids the built-in sk-cp endpoint heuristic and exposes MiniMax-M3 directly.
assumptions.falsifier: The authenticated named-profile catalog request targets api.minimaxi.com or omits MiniMax-M3.

assumptions.statement: Catalog-only provider probes do not consume completion tokens.
assumptions.falsifier: The provider reports billed generation usage for GET /models.

plane_constraints: Home Manager owns durable configuration and SOPS rendering; the live daemon consumes the same default runtime and config paths as CLI and WebTTY clients.
